source: MAPA, Panel de consumo alimentario en hogares
note: Average price paid by households in Spain, volume-weighted over the period (total value / total volume, T.ESPANA). Averages over brands, pack sizes, shops and promotions; not a shop price. Liquids sold per litre are converted to per kg with the density used for the pack sizes. regions: the same average per comunidad autonoma (ISO 3166-2 code), only for foods with data in as many months as the national price; other foods use the national price.
